title: EU27 coordination meeting
description: The EU27 are seeking a common position on the Minister's visit. The biscuits are divided according to a methodology nobody will explain.

attend.label: Attend and argue Bellaluxe's case
attend.text: You secure a speaking slot and an unusually generous biscuit allocation.

delegate.label: Send a colleague with a brief
delegate.text: Your colleague represents the mission. The joint position is less alarming than expected.

decline.label: Decline with apologies
decline.text: The EU27 proceed without you. Someone reallocates the biscuits.

onMiss.text: Nobody from Bellaluxe attends the EU27 meeting. The delegation notices.

title: Valdorian national-day reception
description: Valdoria invites the diplomatic corps to a reception at the golf club. The invitation says 'brief remarks'; staff are arranging extra seating.

attend.label: Attend the reception
attend.text: You congratulate Valdoria and meet half the diplomatic corps before the anthem reaches its third verse.

delegate.label: Send a colleague
delegate.text: Your colleague conveys Bellaluxe's congratulations and returns with three invitations and a tiny flag.

decline.label: Send diplomatic regrets
decline.text: Valdoria accepts your regrets and sends the programme anyway.

onMiss.text: Valdoria notices the empty Bellaluxe place card at its national-day reception.

title: UN development roundtable
description: UN partners are discussing a project the Minister may visit. All participating organisations request their logos above the title.

attend.label: Attend the roundtable
attend.text: You keep the project discussion on the agenda and the logos on a second page.

delegate.label: Send a colleague
delegate.text: Your representative brings the project partners' priorities back to the mission.

decline.label: Decline the meeting
decline.text: The roundtable continues without Bellaluxe; the project partners take note.

onMiss.text: The UN roundtable goes ahead without a Bellaluxe representative or reply.
